statement: Residue-complexity obstruction package RR.1--RR.2. RR.1: for every L>=3 and s>=L, arbitrarily large N contain a support-minimal distinct-Finset unequal relation wholly in (N^(1-1/L),N], squarefree on primes p>N^(1/L), with maximum active degree two and active-incidence graph an increasingly prime-labelled path of length 2s; largest-prime residue transfer can therefore have arbitrary depth at fixed L and active degree. RR.2: for all unequal r,s>=1, disjoint prime sets A,B and a prime p>max(A union B), the double-star shores A union {p prod B} and B union {p prod A} form a support-minimal bad relation; the balanced top p-fibre transfers a coprime cofactor residue with arbitrary numerator and denominator prime supports.
closes: bounded-support and bounded-radius alteration from fixed roughness and active degree
bounded residue-transfer depth from fixed roughness and active degree
bounded cofactor-residue complexity from top-fibre size
no-reserve future safety of finite lower-prime decisions
dependency_gaps: RR.1--RR.2 do not lower-bound the full transversal number; each individual circuit costs one deletion.
M786R-04 needs a full-occurrence cluster-compression alteration proving loss g(N)=o(log N).
M786R-08 needs a noncircular full-residue owner and an all-N distinct-owner congestion bound g(N)=o(log N).
M786R-12 needs a global telescoping potential and, for the infinite target, a summable revision or zero-upper-density reserve theorem.
Neither tau(H_N)=o(N) nor the coherent infinite natural-density construction is proved; both remain mandatory public targets.
External priority is uncertain because public search for an exact solution to Erdos 786 is prohibited in this campaign.

proved_supporting_result.RR.3: For a minimal bad relation all of whose terms have Omega(n)>=d, every matched full prime-occurrence multigraph is connected and has cycle rank at least (d/2-1)|E|+d/2+1. Turan--Kubilius permits d tending to infinity after deleting o(N) low-Omega integers.
proved_supporting_result.alteration_A: An independently audited top-band circuit star forces g(N)=Omega(log N) for the raw variable-overlap symmetric maximum-degree LLL; common-witness cluster contraction is not refuted.
proved_supporting_result.alteration_B: An independently audited core-with-private-satellites family forces Omega(log N) representatives when each packed circuit selects representatives independently inside itself; cross-cluster alteration is not refuted.
